# Welcome to FED-GRAM Discussions! 👋

GitHub Discussions is the place for questions, ideas, show-and-tell, and
general conversation that **isn't** a bug report or a concrete feature
request (those belong in [Issues](https://github.com/FED-OS/FED-GRAM/issues)).

## Categories

| Category | Use it for |
|----------|-----------|
| **📢 Announcements** | Release notes and project news from maintainers. (Read-only for non-maintainers.) |
| **💬 General** | Anything FED-GRAM-related that doesn't fit elsewhere. |
| **🙋 Q&A** | Questions about using or deploying FED-GRAM. Please search before posting. |
| **💡 Ideas** | Early-stage feature ideas and brainstorming — before they become formal feature requests. |
| **🙏 Show and tell** | Share how you're using FED-GRAM, custom engines, or deployment setups. |
| **🔧 Engines** | Discussion of scraping strategies, platform markup changes, and engine maintenance. |

## Guidelines

1. **Search first.** Someone may have already asked or answered your question.
2. **Be specific.** "It doesn't work" isn't enough — share the URL (if public),
   the platform, the error text, and your environment.
3. **Be kind.** This is a community project run by volunteers. See our
   [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
4. **No private content or secrets.** Never paste cookies, private URLs, or
   personal data. Report security issues privately per [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
5. **Bugs and concrete feature requests go to Issues**, not Discussions. Use
   the issue templates so we get the details we need.

## From discussion to issue

If a Q&A or Idea converges on a concrete, actionable bug or feature, a
maintainer (or you) can convert it into a tracked Issue using the appropriate
template. That keeps actionable work in one place.

Thanks for being part of FED-GRAM! 💛
